verdict.rationale: Meta's own safety blog says trajectories are used for training by default, after PII sanitization. It also says users can opt out of model training entirely with a simple switch in Muse settings, which directly delivers the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out switch exists and works, detail on scope (e.g. whether it is retroactive for data already collected or covers WhatsApp/Mac chats), and the fact that training is opt-out rather than off by default.
